svg.aria-label: Left panel, what changes, 14 to 20 seconds: Version A is C4 + F4, a perfect fourth of 5 semitones; Version B is B3 + F4, a diminished fifth of 6 semitones. Right panel, your response: blank lines for I kept, I moved, the result felt.
svg.title: What changes, and your response

g.text: What changed, and what you make of it
There is no correct feeling to write. Your music stays in your own studio.
How to read this graphic: The left panel states what changed, with the pairs and their
colour bars. The right panel is empty on purpose: complete the sentence in your own
words. There is no right feeling to write.
